title: Email/parse: blobId forced null and unknown properties accepted
description: email.rs:1793-1840: blobId is in PARSE_NULL_FIELDS (RFC 8621 §4.9 nulls only id, mailboxIds, keywords, receivedAt); implicit_id adds "id": null unrequested; unknown property names dropped instead of invalidArguments (RFC 8620 §5.1). Thread/get properties likewise unvalidated. (probe-confirmed for parse) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
